name: Evaton
registryBasis: The Chief Surveyor-General’s public cadastral spatial dataset describes a national polygon layer of surveyed parcels and exposes native PRCL_KEY. Official Emfuleni planning material identifies Evaton within Emfuleni Local Municipality. A point-intersects query at the exact WUP locator returned one CSG “Erven” polygon; only PRCL_KEY and geometry were requested.
pointBasis: UN WUP 2025 population-weighted settlement centroid; this is not a municipal boundary or a parcel-coverage claim.
scopeLimits: 46 valid distinct Chief Surveyor-General Erven references verified in thirteen bounded 0.001-degree cells around the unchanged Evaton WUP settlement locator. Complete object-ID manifests, forced three-row geometry pages, all 46 fresh native PRCL_KEY reads, explicit absence, footprint and binding passed in 59 requests through the existing strict Esri JSON reader. Independent EPSG:32735 GEOS found no invalid geometries, exact duplicates or operation errors, and one 0.0130704 m² boundary overlap. A fresh original native EPSG:4148 response reproduces that overlap as a strip under one millimetre wide over about 54 metres; both full polygons retain it without repair or exclusion and are accepted for bounded reference use. The publisher states its web dataset is beta/not current and coordinates are not legal values; currentness, legal title, survey accuracy and wider citywide completeness remain unverified.
remainingUncertainty: Root still needs to assess the existing CSG provider contract, stable key identity, bounded paging and geometry quality. The CSG disclaimer says the web dataset is beta/not current and coordinates are not legal values; citywide coverage, currentness and legal accuracy are unverified.

officialSources.observation: Chief Surveyor-General describes its spatial component as a computerized map of South African land parcels and administrative boundaries.
Chief Surveyor-General lists parcel types including erven and offers a view-spatial-data route.
CSG warns the web cadastral data is beta/not current and that coordinates are not legal values; sample is retained for research only and runtime is not enabled.
Government-hosted CSG “Erven” feature layer metadata declares polygon geometry, EPSG:4148 source extent, public JSON/GeoJSON query support, and string field PRCL_KEY.
Official Emfuleni municipality spatial-development framework names Evaton among its settlements/nodes.

A public Emfuleni-named ArcGIS layer was inspected as a secondary cross-check only; its ArcGIS item owner metadata did not identify a government publisher. A geometry-only point query returned a two-feature boundary intersection, one carrying the same PRCL_KEY; it was not retained as the primary sample.
